rasterHandling: No raster or video asset is used by either demo, so no baked-in foreign text remains.
timing: No source frame cue, fps, spring setting, easing, random seed or exported duration constant was changed. The 36-code-point Persian prompt is mapped onto the source's 39-character typewriter window. Source prompt specifies a 160-frame cascade despite the 130-frame registry; the harness --duration 160 was used to inspect and render its final breathing beat. The panel MP4 was losslessly trimmed to its source 130-frame length after the shared-duration render; ffprobe confirmed 130 panel frames and 160 cascade frames.
concerns: The upstream reference MP4s each end at frame 129. Cascade frames 130–159 can be judged against the source code and prompt but have no original video frame for a direct comparison.
